technical.summary: Strong technical structure with price at new highs and bullish trend confirmation, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 91, Stoch 98) and below-VWAP price create elevated pullback risk; suitable for contrarian fade or tight-stop entry only.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional accumulation, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 14 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (2 small purchases vs 1 small sale, 92-93 days old) with neutral market sentiment and no recent news data provides insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (197.3) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event imminent, and earnings binary in 14 days—CMCSA faces compounded downside risk in this environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price at 52-week highs with supertrend bullish, RSI extreme overbought, and stochastic bullish cross suggest momentum continuation for contrarian tight-stop entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 91, Stoch 98), zero fundamental conviction, earnings binary in 14 days, VIX crisis levels (197.3), inverted yield curve, and price below VWAP create compounded pullback/breakdown risk with no smart money support.

decision.entry_rationale: Not recommended. Extreme overbought technicals (RSI 91, Stoch 98) combined with zero fundamental conviction, earnings binary in 14 days, and VIX crisis levels create asymmetric downside risk with no smart money support.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 14 days coupled with inverted yield curve and VIX at 197.3 creates binary event risk; overbought technicals offer no margin of safety for pullback.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
